propositions: Extract bridge orchestration from provider workflows into a runner-neutral Python core package exposing the operation through Python library (`rebar.bridge_run`), CLI (`rebar bridge run --profile`), and MCP (`bridge_run` tool).
Preserve existing `MODE` environment variable compatibility in provider configuration while introducing canonical `profile` noun in public interfaces and documentation.

Support five routing profiles (reconcile-check, dry-run, bootstrap-strict, bootstrap-throttle, live) that map to corresponding legacy rebar commands, with the runner handling environment validation, 3600-second timeout, pause-marker validation, and result translation.

Distribute the packaged runner through all three install paths (pip wheel, Homebrew wheel-backed environment, MCP Registry/uvx) and validate wheel contents and installation contracts outside the repository.

Thin GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and GitLab provider wrappers to invoke only `rebar bridge run` with credentials/scheduling/artifacts handled natively, while validating provider schemas and embedded shell against pinned ShellCheck.
Direct legacy reconcile callers retain benign results 3/4/75; only the new provider runner maps benign legacy results to canonical 0, preserving operational 1 and invalid-invocation 2.
